method: Bounded purposive manual review after selection and without access to candidate outputs. Positive sources require verified applicability to the proposed test, not merely an overlapping symptom. Author hints and same-repo history are scored separately. Remaining origins are unknown and are excluded from labeled precision/recall; their results still require later independent review. These labels do not constitute a completed 30-case quality benchmark.

cases.decision: Disable the collected early-pipelines scheduling history without deleting or disabling the shader cache or native pipeline library. Check old history stays intact, then isolate same-cache startup order.
cases.note: Source explicitly linked in the origin. No cross-fork visual validation is claimed.

cases.decision: Reuse the card-room retry test across later(), partly(), and recheck(). Ensure a stale retry does not remove the hold for a newer descriptor generation.
cases.note: The origin description already names both sources. Classify declared adaptation, not a novel find.

cases.decision: Validate launcher cold/warm, explicit skip, and failed-pretranslation continuation with a stand-in executable.
cases.note: Named by the origin, inside the receiver. Exclude from cross-project novelty and recall.

cases.decision: Add a two-mode check using a path whose OEM and ANSI encodings differ. GetDiskFreeSpaceA must convert via the current process file API mode and find the same path as GetDiskFreeSpaceW in BOTH modes; restore process mode afterward. Avoid conflating GetDiskFreeSpaceExA fallback with the narrower API.
cases.note: The origin already has an OEM-vs-Wide test and names the independent fork's one-line fix. Wine/mode-switch evidence covers the additional ANSI/OEM transition. The expected search entity is independent implementation or public API contract with equivalent detail.

cases.decision: Check the edit against the receiving repository's existing code. This is wording about existing file advancement, duplicated format documentation, and a truncated prose fragment.
cases.note: The public diff changes only docs/animation.md. A datastream overread patch elsewhere is a hard negative and not useful here. This does not assert the entire world contains no equivalent tool.

cases.decision: Check that the documentation points to the current receiving-repo code and removes a truncated merge fragment.
cases.note: The public diff changes only docs/restofworld.md and asks for existing links, not decoder changes. A cross-project mesh decoding feature would not answer this review.

cases.decision: Add INPUT_ATTACHMENT to the view-format feature matrix, testing COLOR_ATTACHMENT or DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT independently of the COLOR_ATTACHMENT usage bit. Under test, one override with SAMPLED remaining succeeds; a zero mask exercises a distinct validation error. Use override bits within the parent image's allowed usage. Verify against the supported Vulkan version/extension before proposing runtime behavior.
cases.note: The PR's mapping covers six other usage bits but not INPUT_ATTACHMENT. the historical issue reproduces validation remaining after stripping COLOR_ATTACHMENT on the same packed view format. Treat port/adaptation as a suggestion, not verified project behavior.
